description:
Title: Blizzard Online Character Generator

Blizzard creates a cool online tool for creating characters for their new WoW expansion.
When creating a World of Warcraft character, you can start doing two things: 
While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names.
The setup of your account starts with checking whether you have a battle.net account.
If you do not have one yet, you enter the account information and click the link you receive in the confirmation mail.
As soon as you have a battle.net account, you can check if you have an active WoW subscription.
If not, you can select the payment method.
If you choose credit card, enter your credit card information.
If you choose your bank account, enter your IBAN and BIC numbers.
After that you can log into the game and select realm, race and class of your character.
Until now, you should have come up with some good names.
You enter them one by one until a name is still available.
You get a confirmation, and some selfies of your character, as soon as a expansion is released you get another message.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/blizzard-character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CharacterGenerator">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CharacterCreator"
                      name="Character creator"
                      processRef="Process_CharacterGenerator"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ExpansionRelease" name="Expansion release"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ExpansionRelease"
                      name="Expansion release message"
                      sourceRef="Participant_ExpansionRelease"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_ExpansionReleased"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CharacterGenerator"
                name="Blizzard Online Character Generator"
                isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" name="Start creating a character">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Set up account and come up with names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_AccountCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_ThinkNames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check for a Battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_AccountCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountCheck_To_HasAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasAccount" name="Battle.net account exists?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountCheck_To_HasAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasAccount_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasAccount_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterAccountInfo" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasAccount_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterInfo_To_ClickLink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click the link in the confirmation email">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterInfo_To_ClickLink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClickLink_To_AccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountMerge" name="Continue account setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasAccount_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClickLink_To_AccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountMerge_To_SubscriptionCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckSubscription" name="Check for an active WoW subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountMerge_To_SubscriptionCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionCheck_To_Active</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" name="Active WoW subscription?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionCheck_To_Active</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Subscription_Active</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Subscription_Inactive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select a payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Subscription_Inactive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectPayment_To_Method</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectPayment_To_Method</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_CreditCard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_BankAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCreditCard" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_CreditCard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterBankDetails" name="Enter IBAN and BIC numbers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_BankAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankAccount_To_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Continue after entering payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankAccount_To_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMerge_To_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge" name="Continue to log in">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Subscription_Active</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMerge_To_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionMerge_To_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Login" name="Log into the game">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionMerge_To_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_To_SelectCharacter</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" name="Select realm, race and class">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_To_SelectCharacter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectCharacter_To_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ThinkNames" name="Come up with character names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_ThinkNames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThinkNames_To_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Account setup and names ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectCharacter_To_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThinkNames_To_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_To_EnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterName" name="Enter a character name">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_To_EnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameUnavailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterName_To_CheckAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckNameAvailability" name="Check name availability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterName_To_CheckAvailability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckAvailability_To_NameDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Is the name available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckAvailability_To_NameDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameUnavailable</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndSelfies"
               name="Receive confirmation and character selfies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameAvailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CharacterCreated" name="Character creation confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpansionReleased_To_MessageReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExpansionReleased"
                                  messageRef="Message_ExpansionReleased"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveExpansionMessage" name="Receive another message">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpansionReleased_To_MessageReceived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MessageReceived_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExpansionMessageReceived" name="Expansion release message received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MessageReceived_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_ParallelSplit"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateCharacter"
                       targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_AccountCheck"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"
                       targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_ThinkNames"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"
                       targetRef="Task_ThinkNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountCheck_To_HasAccount"
                       sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount"
                       targetRef="Gateway_HasAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount_Yes"
                       name="Yes"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount"
                       targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasBattleNetAccount</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount_No"
                       name="No"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount"
                       targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not hasBattleNetAccount</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterInfo_To_ClickLink"
                       sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo"
                       targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClickLink_To_AccountMerge"
                       sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"
                       targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_To_SubscriptionCheck"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AccountMerge"
                       targetRef="Task_CheckSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionCheck_To_Active"
                       sourceRef="Task_CheckSubscription"
                       targetRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Subscription_Active"
                       name="Yes"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription"
                       targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasActiveWoWSubscription</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Subscription_Inactive"
                       name="No"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription"
                       targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not hasActiveWoWSubscription</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_To_Method"
                       sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod"
                       targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_CreditCard"
                       name="Credit card"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"
                       targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCard">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "credit card"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_BankAccount"
                       name="Bank account"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"
                       targetRef="Task_EnterBankDetails">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "bank account"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge"
                       sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCard"
                       targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount_To_PaymentMerge"
                       sourceRef="Task_EnterBankDetails"
                       targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_To_Login"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"
                       targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionMerge_To_Login"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge"
                       targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_To_SelectCharacter"
                       sourceRef="Task_Login"
                       targetRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectCharacter_To_ParallelJoin"
                       sourceRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions"
                       targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThinkNames_To_ParallelJoin"
                       sourceRef="Task_ThinkNames"
                       targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_To_EnterName"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"
                       targetRef="Task_EnterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_To_CheckAvailability"
                       sourceRef="Task_EnterName"
                       targetRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_To_NameDecision"
                       sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"
                       targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable"
                       name="Available"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndSelfies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nameIsAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameUnavailable"
                       name="Unavailable; enter another name"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"
                       targetRef="Task_EnterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not nameIsAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_To_End"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndSelfies"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_CharacterCreated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionReleased_To_MessageReceived"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_ExpansionReleased"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveExpansionMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MessageReceived_To_End"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReceiveExpansionMessage"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_ExpansionMessageReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
